title: 第210章 依旧强势第209章 无需解释的实力
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 红鹰猎人团成员正聚集在一栋老建筑的咖啡馆里。
这间咖啡馆离公园不到五百米，此刻他们可以清楚的看到那巨大的空层。
近距离感受帝王级生命的恐怖后，他们才真切意识到那个正在与不眠者对抗的人有多么强大。
偏偏这位强大之人竟是他们猎人团的成员，跟着他们同吃同住个把月，被当做新人去对待。
“姚姜，你……你是不是已经知道了？”黄临结结巴巴的问道。
副团长广熊此时也是一副呆若木鸡的模样，她目光望向姚姜，又望向宋笛。
姚姜与宋笛脸上震惊之色无以复加。
“我们……我们……我们是知道梵墨不一般，可……可我们不知道他……”两女已经不知该说什么了。
她们确实知道梵墨在扮猪吃虎，清楚对方是一名尊贵的超阶空间系法师，可在她们看来，莫凡可能是一头狮子，万万想不到是一条龙啊！
哪有一条龙扮成猪的！
他们在冰岛当牛马这么久，连一位法圣的圈子都没有混进去，万万想不到真正的大人物就在他们队伍里，而且是名望远超那些法圣的存在……
“我以为的梵墨，顶破天也就是一个超阶，我哪能知道他是……他是真禁咒啊！”姚姜说道。
那次在酒馆，姚姜自以为了解了这个青年的底细，原来那也不过是冰山一角！
莫凡带给红鹰猎人团的震撼太猛烈了，以至于他们都有些恍惚！
此刻，这位猎人团的新人正一人力敌不眠者，那不眠者再次被他给击倒，看到帝王的身上多了无数触目惊心的伤痕……
举全团之力才勉强杀死一头君主级的巨魔，还是受了重伤的巨魔，更不用说帝王级的存在，他们所有人加起来怕无法在这位帝王面前活过半柱香时间！
“所以我们队伍里出现了一尊大佛，而我们居然还不知道供着！”
“你们看那些法圣，一个个跟缩头乌龟一样……”
“团长，我听那边传来的消息，梵墨好像就是莫凡。”
“莫凡？？哪个莫凡？？”黄临脑子都有些短路了，下意识的问了一句。
“你是不是脑袋被冻傻了，还能是哪个莫凡啊！！”
“卧槽！！他是莫凡？？？”
“穆宁雪……莫凡……原来是他们，我们国内最年轻的两大禁咒！”
整座雷克雅不断晃动着，而古地穴中更是处在大地震。
莫凡手持着一柄魔法神圣之矛，此矛是由古地穴中那些火山岩构成，他以天种土系来催动着整片古地穴中的岩元素，更借助了阴曹黄主的晶痕灾厄，最终塑出了这样一柄恐怖至极的地晶神矛！
地晶神矛长度足以横跨雷克雅城东西两区，当莫凡催动着这根地晶神矛时，人们清楚的感受到城市都陷下去了几分，正是莫凡施展这道神通时摧毁了古地穴支撑结构。
content_en:
Members of the Red Eagle Hunters are gathering in a cafe in an old building.
This cafe was less than five hundred meters away from the park, and they could clearly see the huge void at this moment.
After experiencing the terror of emperor-level life at close range, they truly realized how powerful the person who was fighting against the Sleepless One was.
It just so happened that this powerful man was actually a member of their hunter group. He ate and lived with them for a few months and was treated like a newcomer.
"Yao Jiang, you...do you already know?" Huang Lin asked stammering.
The deputy leader Guang Xiong also looked dumbfounded at this time. She looked at Yao Jiang and then at Song Di.
Yao Jiang and Song Di's faces couldn't be more shocked.
"We...we...we know that Fan Mo is extraordinary, but...but we don't know that he..." The two women no longer knew what to say.
They did know that Fan Mo was pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger, and they knew that the other party was a distinguished super-level space mage. However, in their opinion, Mo Fan might be a lion, but they never imagined that he was a dragon!
How can there be a dragon dressed as a pig!
They have been working as cows and horses in Iceland for so long, and they have not even gotten into the circle of a Dharma Saint. They never expected that a real big shot is in their team, and his reputation far exceeds those of Dharma Saints...
"I thought that Fan Mo, Ding Po Tian, was a super level. How could I know that he was... he was a true forbidden curse!" Yao Jiang said.
That time in the tavern, Yao Jiang thought he knew the details of this young man, but it turned out that it was just the tip of the iceberg!
The shock that Mo Fan brought to the Red Eagle Hunters was so violent that they were all in a trance!
At this moment, the newcomer of the hunter group was fighting against the Sleepless Man alone. The Sleepless Man was knocked down by him again, and he saw countless shocking scars on the emperor's body...
It took the entire team's strength to barely kill a monarch-level troll, but it was still a seriously injured troll, let alone an emperor-level existence. All of them together were afraid that they would not be able to survive half a stick of incense in front of this emperor!
"So a giant Buddha appeared in our team, and we didn't even know how to worship it!"
"Look at those Dharma Saints, they all look like turtles..."
"Captain, I heard the news from over there, Fan Mo seems to be Mo Fan."
"Mo Fan?? Which Mo Fan??" Huang Lin's brain was a little short-circuited and he asked subconsciously.
"If your head is frozen, who else could you be?"
"Fuck!! He is Mo Fan???"
"Mun Ningxue...Mo Fan...it turns out to be them, the two youngest forbidden curses in our country!"
…
The entire Reykjah was shaking continuously, and there was a huge earthquake in the ancient crypt.
Mo Fan is holding a magical sacred spear. This spear is made of volcanic rocks in the ancient crypt. He uses the earth element to activate the rock elements in the entire ancient crypt. He also uses the crystal mark disaster of the Yin Cao Huang Lord to finally create such a terrifying earth crystal spear!
The Earth Crystal Divine Spear was long enough to span the east and west districts of Reykja City. When Mo Fan activated the Earth Crystal Divine Spear, people clearly felt that the city had sunk a bit. It was Mo Fan who destroyed the ancient crypt support structure when he used this magical power.
